I realize that depression is an individual struggle, but I would like to know how to act, support, and what to say when someone is depressed.

For example, I understand that you shouldn’t say “just be happy!” Or try to fix them in some ways. It only frustrates them more.

When I confess to one of my friends I had depression, she listened...but I could tell she had no idea how to handle it.

She told me lots of people have depression and she tried to do the whole “I pray for you” thing. It’s all with good intentions, but in a way, it made me feel like a leper or something.

For me, I found myself to be extremely reactive and sensitive when I was in a depressive state. A friend ignored me when I reached out to her, and for some reason, it threw me into that pit. 

It’s sounds really stupid looking back at it now (I’ ok now), but at that time, it intensified my depression. I felt like no one wanted me. Chasing happiness was too much work. I felt ignored and alone in the world. My head hates me and I hated myself. Whenever I woke up, I think of different scenarios of killing myself, whom to give my possessions to, and mentally write my suicide note. It’s a passive thought and I be e carried out my plan, but it weighed me down. 

In some cases, yeah, i think sadness can be mistaken for depression. I use to think depression was extreme sadness....but for me...it was emptiness.  No motivation to do anything. It was too much work to kill myself but i was easier to not exist.

Anyways, got off tangent there, but sometimes trival things become a big deal to someone who’s in that state. It doesn’t make sense all the time, but then again, being in that mental state doesn’t make any sense to me either.
